from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for col in range(width):
        if all(row[col] == grid[0][col] for row in grid):
            left_width = col
            right_width = width - col - 1
            if left_width and left_width == right_width:
                left = [row[:col] for row in grid]
                right = [row[col + 1:] for row in grid]
                break
    else:
        for row_idx, row in enumerate(grid):
            if all(value == row[0] for value in row):
                top_height = row_idx
                bottom_height = height - row_idx - 1
                if top_height and top_height == bottom_height:
                    left = grid[:row_idx]
                    right = grid[row_idx + 1:]
                    break
        else:
            raise ValueError("No equal-sized panels separated by a uniform line")

    shared = set(value for row in left for value in row) & set(value for row in right for value in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one shared panel color")
    background = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == b else background for a, b in zip(left_row, right_row)]
            for left_row, right_row in zip(left, right)]
'''
path=programs/'task-d7e9b32c.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path, path.exists())
